name: Pečurka Inokulator
description: Ti si inokulant u Guncati laboratoriji. Klikni u sterilni prozor pre nego što kontaminacija preuzme supstrat — 10 nivoa, sve brže.

modules.src/main.js: Bootstrap, game loop (requestAnimationFrame), wire svih modula
modules.src/config.js: Sve konstante: 10-nivo tabela (window duration, speed, score), palette hex, breakpoints
modules.src/state.js: Game state shape (nivo, score, životi, streak, combo, highscore), save/load localStorage
modules.src/input.js: Click + touch handlers, debounce 150ms, action dispatch
modules.src/timing.js: Window mehanika: oscilacija (sinusoid/linear), speed scaling, smjer promene, treper logika
modules.src/render.js: Canvas draw: sto, vreće, timing bar, window pass, background decorations, overlay
modules.src/entities/bag.js: Vreća/tegla entitet: pozicija, status (clean/inoculated/contaminated), animacioni state
modules.src/entities/window.js: Timing window entitet: trenutna pozicija, brzina, tip (zeleni/zlatni/fake), blink state
modules.src/systems/progression.js: Nivo logika: unlock, prelaz na sledeći nivo, perfect bonus kalkulacija, seed za nivo 7–8
modules.src/systems/collision.js: Provera da li je klik unutar zelenog prozora (1D range check na timing bar-u)
modules.src/ui.js: HUD (score, životi, nivo, streak counter), menji (start screen, game over, level clear, tutorial overlay)
modules.src/audio.js: Web Audio API: svi SFX i ambient loop (OscillatorNode, GainNode, BiquadFilterNode)
modules.src/content/facts.js: 4 Guncati edukativna fakta za rotaciju (game over + level clear)
modules.src/share.js: Copy score to clipboard + Web Share API (navigator.share fallback na clipboard)
modules.styles/base.css: Layout: full-screen canvas, body reset, font stack
modules.styles/ui.css: HUD elementi, dugmad, overlay menji, tutorial tooltip stilovi
modules.styles/game.css: Animacije: plesni rast, micelij širenje, screen shake (CSS keyframes)
